1. (Currently Amended) A controller defined by:a base comprising:
a top surface comprising an upper contact that provides for releasable attachment of an associated first accessory;
an opposed bottom surface comprising a lower contact that provides for releasable attachment of an associated second accessory;
an elongated handle positioned adjacent to the top surface, the handle comprising a plurality of rotatable handle buttons positioned on one face of the handle between a top surface ofthe handle and an opposed bottom surface ofthe handle;
a foundation positioned between the handle and the bottom surface;
one more accessories comprising a plurality of accessory buttons, wherein each accessory is configured to releasably attach to the upper contact, lower contact, or both;
wherein the handle buttons are configiured to rotatecan be rotated from a first orientation to a second orientation to accommodate left and right handed use while a remainder of the handle remains stationary.
2. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein the handle is angled relative to the top surface and the foundation.
3. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein the handle buttons are positioned vertically on the handle.
4. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein the handle buttons are selected from push buttons, toggle switches, triggers, directional pads, analog sticks, joysticks,touchscreens, rollerballs, or combinations thereof.
5. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein the accessory buttons are selected from push buttons, toggle switches, triggers, directional pads, analog sticks, joysticks,touchscreens, rollerballs, or combinations thereof.
6. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein each handle button is rotatable about 180 degrees from the first orientation to the second orientation.
7. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein each handle button is independently rotatable relative to one or more other handle buttons.
8. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein each handle button is configured to rotate up to about 180 degrees from the first orientation to the second orientation.
9. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein the base top surface and bottom surface include planar regions.
10. (Original) The controller of claim 1, wherein the upper contact comprises an indented region and the lower region includes a cutout region.
11. (Original) The controller of claim 1, configured as a video game controller.
12. (Original) A method of performing an action on a receiving system using the controller of claim 1, the method comprising:adjusting the rotatable handle buttons to accommodate one or more fingers of a user;
releasably attaching at least one of the accessories to the top contact, lower contact, or both;
wherein the receiving system can be controlled using a single hand of a user and wherein the single hand of the user has access to both the handle buttons and the accessory buttons.
13. (Original) The method of claim 12, wherein the accessories are releasably attached using as snap fit, push fit, magnets, mechanical elements, or combinations thereof.
14. (Original) The method of claim 12, wherein the handle is angled relative to the top surface and the foundation.
15.(Original) The method of claim 12, wherein the handle buttons are positioned vertically on the handle.
16. Original) The method of claim 12, wherein the handle buttons are selected from push buttons, toggle switches, triggers, directional pads, analog sticks, joysticks,touchscreens, rollerballs, or combinations thereof.
17.Original) The method of claim 12, wherein the accessory buttons are selected from push buttons, toggle switches, triggers, directional pads, analog sticks, joysticks,touchscreens, rollerballs, or combinations thereof.
18. Original) The method of claim 12, wherein each handle button is rotatable about 180 degrees from the first orientation to the second orientation.
19.Original) The method of claim 12, wherein each handle button is independently rotatable relative to one or more other handle buttons.
20. Original) The method of claim 12, wherein each handle button is configured to rotate up to about 180 degrees from the first orientation to the second orientation.
